claims.quote: This packet contains fallible location distributions over 4x4 local grids for red and blue roles at nodes n0n3 in panels p0 and p1.
claims.reason: Packet includes coordinate_system rows:4 columns:4 and per-panel per-node 'distributions' matrices for 'red' and 'blue' across nodes n0..n3 and panels p0,p1.
Each panel/node entry has both 'red' and 'blue' distributions.
coordinate_system specifies rows:4 and columns:4; distributions are 4x4 arrays.
Panels list node entries for n0,n1,n2,n3.
Packet has two panels with 'panel' fields p0 and p1 presenting distributions.

claims.quote: in both panels p0 and p1 node n0 distributions for both roles are uniform across all 16 cells.
claims.reason: current entries for p0 and p1 node n0 show each 'red' and 'blue' distribution as all 0.0625 across the 4x4 grid.

claims.quote: in both panels blue peaks are on cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)
while red peaks are on (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1) for n1;

claims.reason: current.p0.n2.derived.blue.peaks and current.p1.n2.derived.blue.peaks list [[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]], i.e. swapped relative to n1.
current.p0.n2.derived.red.peaks and current.p1.n2.derived.red.peaks list [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]], i.e. swapped relative to n1.

claims.quote: Node n3 current in p0 is concentrated on blue (1,2) and red (0,1);
claims.reason: current panel p0 node n3 'derived' shows blue.peaks [[1,2]] and red.peaks [[0,1]].

claims.quote: in p1 current n3 places blue mass on the four-cell set (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) and red on (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1).
claims.reason: current panel p1 node n3 'derived' lists blue.peaks [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]] and red.peaks [[0,0],[0,1],[1,0],[1,1]].

claims.quote: Candidate records under commands k0, k1, k2 show alternative conditional estimates;
claims.reason: packet.candidates includes k0,k1,k2 candidate entries with differing 'derived' distributions across nodes and panels.

claims.quote: for example p1 node n3 ranges across candidates from uniform (k1)
claims.reason: candidates.panel p1 k1 node n3 derived.blue shows peaks covering all 16 cells and entropy 2.7725887 (uniform).
candidates.p1.k0.n3.derived.blue.peaks lists [[0,2],[0,3],[1,2],[1,3]] and current.p1.n3.derived.blue.peaks lists the same set.

claims.quote: to a strong single-cell blue peak at (1,2) under k2.
claims.reason: candidates.p1.k2.n3.derived.blue.peaks lists [[1,2]] with peak_probability ~0.9998878 indicating a strong single-cell peak under k2.

claims.quote: Copied prior records are not new estimates,
claims.reason: Packet origin fields include 'inherited_origin.kind':'copied_prior_record' distinguishing these records from entries whose origin.kind indicates 'command_estimate' or 'history_estimate'; that supports treating copied_prior_record as non-new estimates in packet semantics.

claims.quote: and conditional command records are not events that have occurred.
claims.reason: Packet 'candidate_semantics' states 'conditional supplied record or estimate, not an executed branch', so candidate/command records are represented as conditional/estimated, not executed events.
